grain.scope:
Known-input grain aperture covariance audit, not a fit to film/scan texture.

Measures the existing grain operator on a fixed uniform dye-equivalent channel.
The 48um target is the engine's stipulated estimate, not measured 800T density.
No production code or presets are changed. References use discrete convolution
variance of independent standard normals, rather than final-RGB comparisons.
grain.analytic_reference: For IID zero-mean unit-variance x, Var(q*x)=sum(q**2). Pixel-normalised smoothing induces covariance; aperture variance uses convolution of the averaging and smoothing kernels.

acceptance.scope: Acceptance of this fixed synthetic experiment, not a production-ready grain correction or measured film validation.

grain.units: dye-equivalent channel coefficient; not Status M or measured 800T density. A fixed monochromatic dye coefficient multiplies all these RMS values by the same factor but does not change their resolution ratios.
limitations: Uniform synthetic state, no scanner/noise/sharpening or real texture used.
48um is a circular tile-average measurement; unresolved subpixel grain unknown.
Engine rms48 and grain blur are stipulated estimates, not actual 800T granularity measurements.

Nominal 128um aperture-centre spacing can round to 125um while composed pixel/filter support reaches +/-62.5um, so neighbouring apertures may weakly share edge inputs. Global per-realisation n.std() also induces common dependence; Gaussian confidence intervals are approximate, not a strict coverage guarantee.
No identical realisation is expected across resolutions; compare ensemble statistics.
Audit-only covariance correction targets this stipulated aperture; its PSD/material realism is not validated.

transport.scope:
Independent numerical audit of the existing conditional halation kernel.

No real images, inferred material coefficients, development, or scanner outputs.
The reference integrates the *same declared angular model*, with no 800T claim.
All powers are dimensionless conditional input-energy fractions, not layer H.
transport.pixel_semantics: Reference: point source at pixel centre to receiver pixel area. Finite-area source pixels require a further source-footprint integral; no universal replacement-kernel claim.
transport.decision: Numerical reference only. No production change or 800T attribution. Existing square support and circular normalization mismatch is a small identified implementation inconsistency; material and real-scene attribution remain frozen.

spectral.scope:
One controlled metamer construction, without fitting film or a target image.

Four fixed nonnegative source SPDs provide one null direction for each of three
specified, linear, three-channel observers. Splitting that direction into its
positive and negative parts gives additive mixtures with identical observations.
One COMMON gain scales both mixtures; neither is independently white-balanced,
normalised or exposed. The film response is the frozen 5219-derived model and
the return response is its uncalibrated optical proxy, not measured 800T.

This is an input identifiability diagnostic, not a correction or real-scene fit.
spectral.signal_convention: 81 samples, 380..780nm at5nm; existing common engine summation convention, not SI radiance. One common gain per pair, no independent exposure or colour normalisation.
spectral.observer_scope: CIE observer is the current ideal camera approximation. Nikon/Sigma are library measurements of other cameras; none is Panasonic G81. Actual sensor filters, lenses and calibration can differ.
spectral.film_scope: Frozen next_sensor 5219-derived sensitivity and fixed-reference return proxy. No development, scanner, final RGB, actual photo, fitted material coefficient or candidate change.
spectral.decision: Identical three-channel measurements do not uniquely determine model layer/return exposure even within a small nonnegative source-mixture family. Additional unsaturated bracket exposures at the same channel sensitivities scale the same three observations and do not remove this ambiguity. This does not quantify the real corridor error or identify its cause; no physical correction justified.

Compact single-lens and metasurface systems; not a calibrated lamp/HDR/PSF measurement or 800T dataset. README data link points at Hugging Face but files were not inspected; do not conclude RAW absence. No physical constants inferred.
